prerequisites: Vorwissen IT-Sicherheit ist wünschenswert aber nicht notwendig.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have a broad understanding of cybersecurity. They know the vulnerabilities of various communication protocols. They can describe attack methods on networks, systems, and applications and explain the different effects of corresponding attacks.

Students have understood why companies can only protect themselves to a limited extent against cyberattacks. They can assess to what extent attacks can be prevented by preventive measures and how reactive measures are set up and operated.
Students understand how cyberattacks occur and can be detected.
Students can investigate systems for vulnerabilities and analyze attacks. Students are proficient in using the corresponding network security tools.

syllabus_topics: Tasks of Cybersecurity Analysts in companies
Security-specific operating system fundamentals: Windows and Linux
Network protocols, services, and their vulnerabilities
Logging and log analysis of systems and standard applications
Security Monitoring and Intrusion Detection tools
Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) in companies
assessment_rules: The lecturer chooses the type of graded examination. For the graded examination, a written exam (duration according to the valid study regulations), an oral exam (duration according to the general examination regulations), or a presentation (approx. 20 minutes) with an accompanying written elaboration (approx. 5-10 pages) can be chosen. The ungraded examination performance is an experimental work, consisting of approximately 12 experiments in total.
bibliography: V. Troia, "Hunting Cyber Criminals: A Hacker's Guide to Online Intelligence Gathering Tools and Techniques", Wiley
